source.title_or_context: References that support the recommendations are summarized in [Online Data Supplement 31](#).

table_assessment.assessment_notes: Exact-content review identified 11 assertion-bearing text unit(s). Medication recommendations, source-native grades, and mixed procedure/device/value content were kept distinct; labels remain agent silver pending human adjudication.

Source-native grade preserved without cross-system normalization.

text_units.verbatim_text: 1. In patients with HCM, SCD risk stratification should be performed at the time of initial evaluation and periodically thereafter (S7.4-1–S7.4-8).

entities.surface_form: In patients with HCM who have survived an SCA due to VT or VF

source_grade_records.notes: Source-native grade preserved without cross-system normalization.
Source-native grade preserved without cross-system normalization.

text_units.verbatim_text: 2. In patients with HCM who have survived an SCA due to VT or VF, or have spontaneous sustained VT causing syncope or hemodynamic compromise, an ICD is recommended if meaningful survival greater than 1 year is expected (S7.4-1,S7.4-6,S7.4-9,S7.4-10).

entities.surface_form: In first-degree relatives of patients with HCM

source_grade_records.notes: Source-native grade preserved without cross-system normalization.
Source-native grade preserved without cross-system normalization.

text_units.verbatim_text: 3. In first-degree relatives of patients with HCM, an ECG and echocardiogram should be performed (S7.4-11–S7.4-17).

entities.surface_form: In first-degree relatives of patients with HCM due to a known causative mutation

source_grade_records.notes: Source-native grade preserved without cross-system normalization.
Source-native grade preserved without cross-system normalization.

text_units.verbatim_text: 4. In first-degree relatives of patients with HCM due to a known causative mutation, genetic counseling and mutation-specific genetic testing are recommended (S7.4-13–S7.4-15,S7.4-18,S7.4-19).

entities.surface_form: In patients with clinically suspected or diagnosed HCM

source_grade_records.notes: Source-native grade preserved without cross-system normalization.
Source-native grade preserved without cross-system normalization.

text_units.verbatim_text: 5. In patients with clinically suspected or diagnosed HCM, genetic counseling and genetic testing are reasonable (S7.4-13–S7.4-15,S7.4-18–S7.4-22).

entities.surface_form: In patients with HCM and 1 or more of the following risk factors

source_grade_records.notes: Source-native grade preserved without cross-system normalization.
Source-native grade preserved without cross-system normalization.

text_units.verbatim_text: 6. In patients with HCM and 1 or more of the following risk factors, an ICD is reasonable if meaningful survival of greater than 1 year is expected: a. Maximum LV wall thickness ≥30 mm (LOE: B-NR) (S7.4-2,S7.4-3,S7.4-23,S7.4-24). b. SCD in 1 or more first-degree relatives presumably caused by HCM (LOE: C-LD) (S7.4-25,S7.4-26). c. 1 or more episodes of unexplained syncope within the preceding 6 months (LOE: C-LD) (S7.4-8,S7.4-26).

text_units.verbatim_text: 7. In patients with HCM who have spontaneous NSVT (LOE: C-LD) (S7.4-2,S7.4-26,S7.4-27) or an abnormal blood pressure response with exercise (LOE: B-NR) (S7.4-5,S7.4-28,S7.4-29), who also have additional SCD risk modifiers or high risk features, an ICD is reasonable if meaningful survival greater than 1 year is expected.

text_units.verbatim_text: 8. In patients with HCM who have NSVT (LOE: B-NR) (S7.4-2,S7.4-26,S7.4-27) or an abnormal blood pressure response with exercise (LOE: B-NR) (S7.4-5,S7.4-28,S7.4-29) but do not have any other SCD risk modifiers, an ICD may be considered, but its benefit is uncertain.

text_units.verbatim_text: 9. In patients with HCM and a history of sustained VT or VF, amiodarone may be considered when an ICD is not feasible or not preferred by the patient (S7.4-30,S7.4-31).

source_grade_records.notes: Source-native grade preserved without cross-system normalization.

text_units.verbatim_text: 10. In patients with HCM, an invasive electrophysiological study with programmed ventricular stimulation should not be performed for risk stratification (S7.4-32,S7.4-33).

text_units.verbatim_text: 11. In patients with an identified HCM genotype in the absence of SCD risk factors, an ICD should not be implanted (S7.4-7,S7.4-34,S7.4-35).
